Hi Marta — thanks for raising this. I'm Marissa on Redwood Finance; we'll own vendor tax onboarding and payment setup. Below is the minimal documentation we need to avoid payment holds and to correctly classify tax reporting. Please return these items as PDFs where possible:

1) Signed W-8BEN-E (full form). Please complete the entire form and sign at the end. If you claim any treaty benefits, indicate the relevant article and provision.
2) Certificate of incorporation / KRS excerpt (company registration).
3) VAT registration / Tax ID (NIP) — please supply your Polish VAT number as it appears on your invoice. If you are charging VAT, confirm the rate and whether this is a B2B taxable supply.
4) Bank details for wire/SEPA: beneficiary name, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, and a bank statement or voided SEPA confirmation to verify the account.
5) Entity relationship table if you have multiple legal entities or a US branch (brief table with contracting entity, registration number, country, and whether payments should flow to that entity).

Notes:
- For Polish/EU suppliers that provide a valid W-8BEN-E, Redwood does not issue 1099s for amounts paid to a foreign entity.
- If any component of the charge is paid to a US subsidiary, we will re-check US person classification for that line.
- If documentation is incomplete, we may have to place the invoice on hold pending KYC. We try to avoid this, but it can delay payment beyond Net 30.

I have attached our standard vendor onboarding checklist to help (vendor_onboarding_checklist_v4.pdf). If you can return the signed W-8BEN-E and the entity table this week, we should be able to process the payment in the next AP cycle.

Best,
